basics.name: Abhigyan Majumdar
basics.label: PhD Candidate in Mechanical & Aerospace Engineering
basics.summary: PhD student at University of California, Davis specializing in System Dynamics & Controls. Working on physics- and learning-based system modeling and controller design for robotics, autonomous driving, vehicle dynamics, and energy storage.

work.name: University of California, Davis CORE Lab
work.summary: Developing novel data-driven Koopman operator identification algorithms for general nonlinear dynamic systems; predictive thermal derating for EV drive units; supervising and mentoring master's students on physics-based EV thermal management models; enhancing drive-by-wire and perception capabilities for autonomous vehicle research.
highlights: Predictive safety filtering for thermal derating of EV systems

work.name: UC Davis EcoCAR Team
work.summary: Led a multidisciplinary team of 15 undergraduates to overhaul the Cadillac LYRIQ powertrain for the EcoCAR EV Challenge; designed and implemented propulsion supervisory controller workflows in MIL, HIL, and VIL environments; ensured functional safety via hazard analysis, requirements traceability, and multi-level testing.
highlights: First Place Propulsion Controls & Modeling Presentation Award, EcoCAR Year 2
Over the HIL Award for best HIL setup across 15 teams

work.name: Farasis Energy, Inc.
work.summary: Implemented reduced-order and coupled electro-thermal simulations of Li-ion battery packs using ANSYS Fluent and TwinBuilder; developed controls-oriented system models to evaluate fast-charging and thermal management algorithms; presented findings at SAE WCX 2023 (DOI: 10.4271/2023-01-0931).

work.name: Bio-Heat Transfer Laboratory, NIT Rourkela
work.summary: Developed combined analytical-numerical solutions for 1D phase-change heat transfer in living tissue during cryosurgery; presented at the 5-6th Thermal and Fluids Engineering Conference (DOI: 10.1615/TFEC2021.bio.036282).

awards.title: First Place Propulsion Controls & Modeling Presentation
awards.summary: Ranked first among 15 North American universities for EV propulsion controls software development and validation.

awards.title: Over the HIL Award
awards.summary: Best Hardware-in-the-Loop setup using Speedgoat hardware for EV propulsion supervisory controller testing.

certificates.name: Equivalent Circuit Cell Model Simulation (with Honours)
Learning How to Learn: Powerful Mental Tools

publications.name: Sliding Mode Wheel Slip Control for Regenerative Braking of an All-Wheel-Drive Electric Vehicle
publications.publisher: ASME Letters in Dynamic Systems and Controls
publications.summary: Developed nonlinear sliding-mode controller and validated in a MIL environment under noisy feedback.

publications.name: Thermal Reduced Order Modeling for System Analysis of EV Battery
publications.summary: Coupled electro-thermal simulation of Li-ion packs for fast-charging and thermal control evaluation.

publications.name: Analytical Study of Phase Change Heat Transfer in Biological Tissue using Coordinate Transformation Technique during Cryosurgery
publications.summary: Combined analytical-numerical method for phase-change heat transfer in living tissue.

projects.name: Energy Optimal Dual-Stage Adaptive Cruise Controller for EVs
projects.summary: Designed NMPC for longitudinal adaptive cruise to optimize energy efficiency and comfort under varying traffic.
highlights: Energy, comfort, and safety constraints compliance

projects.name: Autonomous Aerial Landing of Quadcopter
projects.summary: Built MATLAB-Simulink simulation for UAV landing on moving target; developed trajectory generation and adaptive LQR controllers.
highlights: Adaptive LQR for stability under non-linear dynamics
